## Goal
Build a reusable Python client package for Open Brain agent memory under `python/openbrain-memory/`.

This package does **not** replace the remote Open Brain LXC service. It runs on agent hosts like Bilby, Skippy, Nagatha, or automation scripts, and talks to the remote Open Brain service over HTTP/MCP.

## Architecture split
- `rodaddy/open-brain`: owns protocol/client/memory policy package
- `rtech-hermes`: owns Hermes lifecycle adapter only

Runtime path:

```text
Hermes on an agent host
  -> rtech-hermes/plugins/memory/openbrain
    -> openbrain_memory.AgentMemory
      -> HTTP / MCP-over-HTTP
        -> Open Brain service on LXC
          -> Postgres / embeddings / search / tiers / lanes
```

## Initial public API
```python
from openbrain_memory import AgentMemory, OpenBrainClient

client = OpenBrainClient(
    base_url="http://10.71.20.49:3100",
    token=os.environ["OPENBRAIN_TOKEN"],
    namespace="skippy",
)

memory = AgentMemory(client, agent="skippy", project="hermes")
memory.start_session("discord:channel:thread")
memory.remember_fact("OB canary value is blue-lantern")
ctx = memory.recall("what was the OB canary value?")
memory.checkpoint("Canary wrote and recalled OB memory.")
```

## Scope
- Create package at `python/openbrain-memory/`
- Implement `OpenBrainClient`
- Implement `AgentMemory`
- Add safety/policy layer
- Add dream/curation helpers
- Add tests with fake transport, no live tokens required
- Add README quickstart and install notes

## Non-goals
- Do not move the Open Brain service.
- Do not make Hermes the owner of memory policy.
- Do not wire the `rtech-hermes` plugin in this repo.
- Do not require real Open Brain credentials in tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cd python/openbrain-memory && uv run pytest` passes.
- Package exports `AgentMemory` and `OpenBrainClient` from `openbrain_memory`.
- Tests prove fake MCP transport call flow without live Open Brain.
- README explains remote LXC service vs local client package split.
